name: Custom Shape Wall-Mounted Wooden And Acrylic Bookshelf
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and acrylic, combining decorative charm with practical wall-mounted storage.
    - Built with two 5mm wooden main panels, creating a sturdy and durable frame structure.
    - Features 3mm acrylic panels that add a modern layered look and enhance the decorative front design.
    - Designed as a wall-mounted bookshelf/display shelf, perfect for showcasing books, keepsakes, and personalized décor.
    - Includes black & white hanging string, plus screws and anchors for mounting support.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 10 x 10 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. 
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - All main printed components feature 1-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a wall-mounted bookshelf and a personalized decorative home accent.
    - Suitable for displaying lightweight books, decorative cards, framed items, keepsakes, and small accessories.
    - Ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, entryways, nurseries, reading corners, offices, and family spaces.
    - The layered design adds visual depth while keeping the display neat and attractive.
    - Great for home personalization, seasonal décor, and gift-worthy wall styling.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for couples, families, parents, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for housewarmings, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, holidays, and family celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom home décor with both decorative and practical value.
    - Great as a keepsake display shelf for meaningful names, messages, and personalized artwork.
    - A beautiful gift choice that combines organization, décor, and sentimental charm 🏡🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wall-Mounted Wooden And Acrylic Bookshelf

 

PRODUCTION

  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
